{{Quote|Look for a tough Zabrak with orange skin and slashing tattoos on his face. Even his horns have got horns, they say, so watch out.|Bren Kingal|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Kli Sithrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Bren Kingal]] of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find him. Kingal knew of Sithrin's allegiance to the Empire, but in order to avoid a [[Politics/Legends|political]] disagreement, he fooled the spacer into believing that Sithrin was merely a thief. Sithrin, was in fact meeting with an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] official, but was killed by the spacer in the confusion.

==Biography==
{{Quote|That's close enough. What brings you here? A stolen medpack? I stole no medpack. If you must know, I'm meeting here with an ISB official. Hold on, I told you an Imperial secret. Now I suppose I'll have to kill you. Mangler&mdash;attack!|Kli Sithrin|<ref name="SWG:AED" />}}
Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Bren Kingal]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding Kli Sithrin, and taking a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] from him which he supposedly stole from a little [[Gender/Legends|girl]]. However, this was nothing more than a lie, designed to fool the spacer into confronting a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The spacer ended up killing Sithrin, who just prior had called out for Mangler to attack. Whether or not Mangler was the ISB official, or some other companion of his is unclear, as Sithrin ended up fighting the spacer on his own, before being slain.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SharpshooterMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Kli Sithrin]]
[[File:SharpshooterFemaleTemplate.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Kli Sithrin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Kli Sithrin changed each time a player performed this quest. The quest dialogue given by Bren Kingal indicated that Sithrin was a male, but there is some confusion regarding his species. In the quest dialogue, Kingal initially referred to Sithrin as a big Sullustan gangster. Yet, when the player accepted the quest, he then told the player to look for a tough Zabrak with [[orange]] skin and slashing [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]. Kingal had a habit of lying perpetually during his quests, but this was more than likely an error by the developers. In the ''Star Wars Galaxies'' TRE files, Sithrin was consistently referred to as a Zabrak, instead of a Sullustan. Unlike the game, where Kingal initially referred to Sithrin as a big Sullustan, the TRE files have the identical dialogue, but with the word Zabrak substituting the word Sullustan. Furthermore, because Kingal went into much more detail describing Sithrin as a Zabrak (slashing tattoos and horns), this article assumes that Sithrin was a Zabrak, and that the reference to him being a Sullustan was a typo. Furthermore, although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining Sithrin revealed him to be a [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]]. However, it should be noted that this was primarily due to game mechanics, as a result of Sithrin being placed under the randomized sharpshooter spawn template appearance.
